svg.title: NVIDIA backend: 4 of 8 verification stages demonstrated; two readable 4K GPU desktop captures verified; 0 of 4 desktop acceptance gates complete
svg.desc: Four verification stages demonstrated in the lab; guest graphics integration is in progress. Two fresh guests pass bounded 3840 by 2160 NVIDIA captures with the shipped Omarchy wallpaper, bar and readable Alacritty application. A later cleaner-child-payload run fails a native recipient reference and aborts Hyprland. Shared-reference lifetimes, recovery, normal launcher/input and sustained work remain open. No desktop product acceptance gate is complete. Checklist counts do not measure engineering effort. Updated October 19, 2026.
svg.text: Captured: 4K GPU wallpaper, Omarchy bar and readable NVIDIA application
Two diagnostic captures verified; later live-work failure remains open
Next: shared-reference lifetimes, launcher/input and sustained desktop work
Green: demonstrated · Amber: in progress · Gray: pending · Updated 2026-10-19
